author: Aether I
title: CNN-StackedGRU Policy Gradient for Sokoban
abstract: This submission explores a deeper recurrent architecture by implementing two stacked GRU layers after the convolutional feature extraction blocks. The objective is to determine if increased temporal reasoning depth further enhances the agent's planning capabilities and solve rate in the Sokoban environment. Hyperparameters are fixed to the best performing values from Evaluation ID 28.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
import optax
from ray import tune
from typing import Tuple, Dict, Any, Optional, List

BASE_SEED = 42 # For reproducibility

def _define_hyperparameters():
    """
    Define fixed hyperparameters based on the best trial from Evaluation ID 28.
    """
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([0.000259]),  # Fixed to best from Eval ID 28
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.011754]),   # Fixed to best from Eval ID 28
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.573199]),# Fixed to best from Eval ID 28
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([64]),       # Fixed to best from previous trial
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([128]),      # Fixed to best from previous trial
        'gru_features': tune.choice([256])         # Fixed to best from previous trial
    }

class SokobanStackedGRUCNN(nn.Module):
    """CNN with Stacked GRU for Sokoban."""
    cnn_features_1: int
    cnn_features_2: int
    gru_features: int
    
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray, done: jnp.ndarray, rnn_state: Optional[List[jnp.ndarray]] = None) -> Tuple[jnp.ndarray, jnp.ndarray, List[jnp.ndarray]]:
        """Forward pass through the network."""
        batch_size = x.shape[0]
        
        # CNN Feature Extraction (with residual connections)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        
        conv2_in = x
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = x + conv2_in
        x = nn.relu(x)
        
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        
        conv4_in = x
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = x + conv4_in
        x = nn.relu(x)
        
        # Flatten spatial dimensions for GRU input
        x = x.reshape((batch_size, -1))
        
        # Stacked GRU Layers for temporal processing
        # Handle initial RNN states: if None, initialize to zeros for two layers
        if rnn_state is None:
            rnn_state_layer1 = jnp.zeros((batch_size, self.gru_features), dtype=jnp.float32)
            rnn_state_layer2 = jnp.zeros((batch_size, self.gru_features), dtype=jnp.float32)
            rnn_state = [rnn_state_layer1, rnn_state_layer2]
        
        gru_cell1 = nn.GRUCell(features=self.gru_features, name="gru_layer_1")
        new_rnn_state_layer1, gru_out1 = gru_cell1(rnn_state[0], x)
        
        gru_cell2 = nn.GRUCell(features=self.gru_features, name="gru_layer_2")
        new_rnn_state_layer2, gru_out2 = gru_cell2(rnn_state[1], gru_out1) # Output of first GRU feeds into second

        new_rnn_state = [new_rnn_state_layer1, new_rnn_state_layer2]
        
        # Shared MLP backbone after GRU (using output of the last GRU layer)
        x = nn.Dense(features=256)(gru_out2)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        
        # Separate heads for policy and value
        policy_hidden = nn.Dense(features=64)(x)
        policy_hidden = nn.relu(policy_hidden)
        policy_logits = nn.Dense(features=4)(policy_hidden)
        
        value_hidden = nn.Dense(features=64)(x)
        value_hidden = nn.relu(value_hidden)
        value = nn.Dense(features=1)(value_hidden).squeeze(-1)
        
        return policy_logits, value, new_rnn_state

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    """Create and return the CNN-StackedGRU network architecture."""
    return SokobanStackedGRUCNN(
        cnn_features_1=hparams['cnn_features_1'],
        cnn_features_2=hparams['cnn_features_2'],
        gru_features=hparams['gru_features']
    )

# No override for create_optimizer or training_step; using defaults.
